summary.title: BrainFrame P2P Sync Threat Model
summary.description: BrainFrame is a second brain and archiving program. It provides cross platform support (Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and iPhone/iPad), and builds in a way to synchronize data amongst a collection of devices. This threat model focuses on the synchronization mechanism

data.name: Peer
data.description: UI Peer, Headless Peer. Can be reading or writing.

data.name: Engram Files
data.description: Markdown, PDF, EPUB. Eventually will include FLAC, WAV, and video formats.

data.name: .brainframe
data.description: engram identity, version information, per engram settings, such as the visual theme, and peer level identity maps

data.name: app-data
data.description: Per user app-data directory stored per engram. Stores edit history (CRDT operation logs), membership list

data.name: Quarantine Zone
data.description: Data that may be valid, but must be manually inspected

data.name: Documents, Warnings, Pairings
data.description:
Peer renders documents to keeper.
Peer provides warnings to keeper (large documents, quarantined edits, etc)
Peer provides pairing codes to keeper

data.name: Edits, Commands, Pairing
data.description:
Keeper sends edits to the peer.
Keeper sends commands (remove peer, accept quarantined edits)
Keeper confirms pairing with other peers

data.name: File Scan
data.description: The file scan from external edits to the engram files

data.name: File Sync Tools
data.description: External file sync carries edits from other machines directly to the engram files, and vice versa. Also includes sync'ing to/from cloud storage

data.name:
Cloud
Backup
data.description: Files get copied and placed plain, never interpreted.

data.name: Cloud configuration
data.description: Bucket name, object retention policy, etc

data.name: Cloud credentials
data.description: any API keys, IAM configuration, etc
